label: 6A-MBL system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a 6A-MBL locus that can protect bacteria from bacteriophage infection.
observations: 6A-MBL branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual cap2_3 or mblB genes, Cap2-3 or MblB proteins, DefenseFinder HMM profiles, source-database rows naming one 6A-MBL locus, unresolved 6A-MBL trigger or effector activities, and other phage defense systems.
